angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 590,023 km at 127.17 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.8636 +/- 0.0112 mas (same row, RUWE 0.82): 127.17 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.8481 +/- 0.0339 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 590,023 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9027 +/- 0.0223 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5081 +/- 56 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2088 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2088.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.537, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2088: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2088 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.339 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2088 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.36151, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2088 (pscomppars): age 4.5 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
